name: 顶级千金被校草当众拒绝后，她不装了
original_name: 顶级千金被校草当众拒绝后，她不装了
overview: Zhou Jin, a wealthy heiress, spent three years disguised as a poor girl to win a bet by chasing campus heartthrob Liang Ze. When she finally reveals her true identity, past deceptions ignite heartbreak, revenge plots, and unexpected twists, turning a playful scheme into a high-stakes game of love and comeuppance.
